<page>
 Galveston County District Court
 Cause No. 2024-CV-0021
 Megan Gutierrez, Plaintiff, v. Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance, Defendant
 Defendant's Original Answer
Date:
11-13-24
Counsel for defendant:
Marilyn Fox, Ashford & Lyle LLP
Defendant answers Plaintiff's Original Petition by generally dneying each and every allegation contained in it, and
Defendant demands strict proof of every element of Plaintiff's claims by a preponderance of the evidence, as the
Texas Rules of Civil Procedure permit.
For further answer, and without assuming any burden of proof that the law places on Plaintiff, Defendant asserts the
following affirmative defenses. First, Plaintiff's own negligence caused or contributed to the collision, in that Plaintiff
entered the intersection against a traffic control device or failed to yield the right-of-way, and Plaintiff's recovery, if
any, must be reduced or barred under Chapter 33 of the Texas Civil Practice and Remedies Code. Second, the
collision and any claimed injuries were proximately caused by the acts or omissions of a third party over whom
Defendant had no control and for whom Defendant is not legally responsible, which Defendant designates as a
responsible third party. Third, Plaintiff failed to mitigate damages by not following reasonable medical advice and by
not seeking traetment in a timely manner, and any recovery must be reduced accordingly.
Defendant reserves the right to amend this answer as discovery proceeds.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
